paper: M. Narhi, B. Wetzel, C. Billet, S. Toenger, T. Sylvestre, J.-M. Merolla, R. Morandotti, F. Dias, G. Genty, J. M. Dudley, Real-time measurements of spontaneous breathers and rogue wave events in optical fibre modulation instability, Nat. Commun. 7, 13675 (2016)
description: Modulation instability breather and rogue-wave physics in SMF-28. Reproduces (A) the MI gain/sideband frequency, (B) the deterministic MI growth rate vs the analytic gain, (C) the exact Peregrine-soliton profile used in the paper's Fig. 4b, (D) the exact Akhmediev breather, and (E) a noise-seeded spontaneous-MI ensemble showing breather emergence.

derived_reference.note: Analytic values from the paper's parameters.
